timeline.text: When a live interview translation went wrong, there was no way to check why afterward.
No record of what it heard, the rough draft, or how long each step took.
Now every session keeps its own paper trail, stored in Cloudflare D1.
Lose your connection mid-interview? Nothing is lost — it waits on your device and sends itself once you're back online.
The whole session syncs to the cloud every 3 seconds.
